_comment: Optimized player_skills.json - Skills-based progression system. Use-it-to-level-it design inspired by EverQuest + D&D schools. Transmutation merged into Alteration. No separate specialize skills (Option A). Wild Magic retained for Chaosborn. Weapon skills collapsed into type-based categories (blunt / slashing / piercing) for modern design.

physical.athletics: Increases performance in climbing, jumping, swimming, and sustained movement.
physical.dodge: Improves evasion from melee and ranged attacks.
physical.parry: Enables deflection of melee attacks with weapons.
physical.riposte: Allows counterattacks after a successful parry.
physical.block: Raises passive defense and damage absorption when wielding a shield.
physical.shield_defense: Improves blocking effectiveness and damage reduction specifically when wielding a shield.
physical.dual_wield: Allows effective use of two one-handed weapons simultaneously.
physical.double_attack: Grants a chance to strike twice in a single action.
physical.triple_attack: Grants a chance to strike three times in a single action.
physical.mantis_fist: Precision unarmed strikes with speed and accuracy (martial arts).
physical.leopard_strike: Aggressive unarmed attack with a chance to stun (martial arts).
physical.bash: Stuns or interrupts the enemy with a shield or blunt weapon.
physical.taunt: Increases likelihood of drawing and holding enemy attention.
physical.backstab: Delivers high damage from behind or while stealthed using piercing weapons.
physical.hand_to_hand: Improves combat ability and damage when fighting unarmed, includes kicks.
physical.blunt_weapons: Increases proficiency with all blunt weapons (maces, hammers, clubs, staves — both one-handed and two-handed).
physical.slashing_weapons: Increases proficiency with all slashing weapons (swords, axes, glaives — both one-handed and two-handed).
physical.piercing_weapons: Increases proficiency with all piercing weapons (daggers, spears, rapiers, picks — both one-handed and two-handed).
physical.offense: Offensive fighting proficiency used by weapons and physical skills
physical.defense: Defensive proficiency used by blocking, parrying, dodging, etc. and avoiding or mitigating physical attacks
physical.weapon_mastery: General skill improving melee weapon damage, accuracy, and critical chance across all weapon types.
physical.archery: Boosts effectiveness, range, and accuracy with bows and crossbows.
physical.throwing: Improves accuracy, range, and damage when throwing weapons.
physical.offense: Broad combat skill raised by landing melee attacks. Improves overall attack power and accuracy.
physical.defense: Broad defensive skill raised by being attacked in melee. Improves blocking, dodging, and parrying.
physical.musicianship: The ability to sing and play various musical instruments. Improves Troubadour songs.
physical.stealth: Ability to move unseen, reduce detection chance, and enable ambush attacks.
physical.tracking: Ability to follow trails, locate creatures, and read signs in the environment.
physical.bind_wound: Non-magical first aid. Stops bleeding and restores a small amount of health outside of combat.
physical.perception: Ability to notice hidden enemies, traps, secrets, and environmental details.
physical.lockpicking: Ability to open locks and disarm simple mechanical traps.
physical.trapping: Ability to both set and use, and detect and safely disable traps.
physical.legerdermain: Skillful trickery or deception, often involving quick, clever hands, such as in magic tricks or sleight of hand. Includes pickpocketing
physical.cartography: Mapping the land as you travel (M opens your map). Learned from a Scroll of Cartography; needs Blank Parchment and a Charcoal Stick. Rises as you chart new ground, up to 100: place names at 21, camps and resources at 51, patrols and hidden places at 76.

magic.abjuration: Protective and warding magic. Barriers, shields, banishing, damage absorption, and defense against magical effects.
magic.conjuration: Summoning creatures, objects, temporary constructs, and calling allies from other realms.
magic.divination: Revealing hidden information, detection, scrying, insight, and seeing the unseen.
magic.enchantment: Mind-affecting magic, charms, emotional influence, pacify, dominate, and magical imbuing of creatures or objects.
magic.evocation: Elemental and raw energy magic. Direct damage, force effects, radiant/holy bursts, and destructive power.
magic.illusion: Deceptive sensory effects, invisibility, glamers, mirror images, and figments that mislead the senses.
magic.necromancy: Manipulation of life force, death, undead, draining, soul magic, plagues, and blood rites.
magic.alteration: Changing the physical properties, form, movement, size, weight, state, or shape of creatures and objects (includes former Transmutation effects).
magic.wild_magic: Chaotic and unpredictable magic that can produce random elemental effects, surges, or reality-warping results. High risk and reward.
magic.spell_casting: General magical proficiency. Improves overall success rate, potency, and reduces fizzle chance across all schools.
magic.concentration: Ability to maintain focus and complete spells while under pressure, taking damage, or in chaotic conditions.
magic.channeling: Skill at directing and sustaining magical energy without interruption. Helps with channeled and continuous effects.
magic.meditation: Improves mana recovery rate, especially while resting or out of combat.

crafting.alchemy: Creates potions, elixirs, and magical brews from ingredients.
crafting.blacksmithing: Crafts weapons, armor, and metal tools.
crafting.brewing: Makes drinks and simple potions using organic ingredients.
crafting.cooking: Prepares food that restores health and can apply temporary buffs.
crafting.fletching: Crafts arrows, bolts, bows, and ranged implements.
crafting.fishing: Retrieves fish and aquatic resources from water.
crafting.forage: Gathers herbs, roots, and natural ingredients from the terrain.
crafting.jewelcrafting: Crafts rings, amulets, and gem-set accessories.
crafting.leatherworking: Crafts leather armor and accessories from hides.
crafting.prospecting: Locates ore deposits and mines raw materials.
crafting.tinkering: Builds mechanical gadgets and clockwork devices.
crafting.woodworking: Crafts bows, staves, shields, and wooden implements.
